regions_new.name: Andaru
regions_new.notes: Throne vent-shoulder & ash-nomad kin of Zeijani (Ṣunu-Ašru & Šadū-Qarnu); raid colonizers, export fungal goods & Ranj. From Gemini's trade model (openworld/world-pins-gemini.json, 2026-11-14).

settlements_added.name: Eastern highlands harvesters (to be named)
settlements_added.notes: The cushion plateau's harvesters (cushion wool, thorn gum, wormwick, tower honey; biomes/ehighlands/NOTES.md): a flat high basin at 3,502 m, Dsb, ~860 mm, +7 C, ~1.03 atm, on the wet face under the plateau's edge in 'e inner wall'; 223 km2-eq of farmland within 10 km, 380 km2 of cushion ground within 20 km. Culture and lore to come (the owner, 2026-11-12; openworld/TRADE-SCOPE.md 2.5d). Gemini's trade model calls it Guari, a Tiguantin town.

settlements_added.name: Pit-Head 04
settlements_added.notes: The Siphon-Ropers' base camp on the Siphon Pits' maar floor (station 3; +2,277 m, ~2 km under a +4,269 m rim): the woolly siphon's machine-wax rendered into ingots, Yuni's machine-wax works (biomes/siphon-pits/PLAN.md 3). Ostrukh-on-Water ~380 km. The owner, 2026-11-12 (openworld/TRADE-SCOPE.md 2.5c).

settlements_added.name: Coyote village (to be named)
settlements_added.notes: On the south shore of the big fresh lake north of the abyss (~1227,546, 3,428 km2): a knoll by the water. Aw, ~1,270 mm, +26 C, ~148 km2-eq farmland within 10 km. The owner, 2026-11-12 (openworld/TRADE-SCOPE.md 10).
